vv80:1.1: Disvāna devaṃ paṭipucchi bhikkhu: ucce vimānamhi ciraṭṭhitīke āmuttahatthābharaṇo yasassī dibbe vimānamhi yathāsi candimā. || ||
vv80:2.1: Alaṅkato malyadharo suvattho sukuṇḍalī kappitakesamassu āmuttahatthābharaṇo yasassī dibbe vimānamhi yathāsi candimā. || ||
vv80:3.1: Dibbā ca vīṇā pavadanti vaggū aṭṭhaṭṭhakā sikkhitā sādhurūpā dibbā ca kaññā Tidasacarā uḷārā naccanti gāyanti pamodayanti. || ||
vv80:4.1: Deviddhipatto 'si mahāhubhāvo manussabhūto kim akāsi puññaṃ kenāsi evaṃ jalitānubhāvo vaṇṇo ca te sabbadisā pabhāsatī ti. || ||
vv80:5.1: So devaputto attamano Moggallānena pucchito pañhaṃ puṭṭho viyākāsi yassa kammass' idaṃ phalaṃ. || ||
vv80:6.1: Ahaṃ manussesu manussabhūto saṅgamma rakkhissaṃ paresaṃ dhenuyo tato ca āgā samaṇo mam' antike gāvo ca māse agamaṃsu khādituṃ. || ||
vv80:7.1: Dvay' ajja kiccaṃ ubhayañ ca kāriyaṃ icc ev' ahaṃ bhante tadā vicintayiṃ tato ca saññaṃ paṭiladdha yoniso dadāmi bhante ti khipiṃ anantakaṃ. || ||
vv80:8.1: So māsakhettaṃ turito avāsariṃ purā ayaṃ bhañjati yass' idaṃ dhanaṃ tato ca kaṇho urago mahāviso adaṃsi pāde turitassa me sato. || ||
vv80:9.1: Svāhaṃ aṭṭo 'mhi dukkhena pīḷito bhikkhu ca taṃ sāmaṃ muñcitvā nantakaṃ ahāsi kummāsaṃ mamānukampayā tato cuto kālakato 'mhi devatā. || ||
vv80:10.1: Tad eva kammaṃ kusalaṃ kataṃ mayā sukhañ ca kammaṃ anubhomi attanā tayā hi bhante anukampito bhusaṃ kataññutāya abhivādayāmi taṃ. || ||
vv80:11.1: Sadevake loke samārake ca añño muni natthi tayānukampako tayā hi bhante anukampito bhusaṃ kataññutāya abhivādayāmi taṃ. || ||
vv80:12.1: Imasmiṃ loke parasmiṃ vā pana añño muni natthi tayānukampako tayā hi bhante anukampito bhusaṃ kataññutāya abhivādayāmi taṃ. || || Gopālavimānaṃ
